canonical_statement: For an independent identically distributed sequence of real-valued random variables on a probability space, integrability of the reference variable implies that the arithmetic means converge in probability to the common expectation.

conclusion: TendstoInMeasure mu (fun n omega => empiricalAverage X n omega) atTop (fun _ => mu[X 0]).
